note: CVE patch floors from the README and upstream loader documentation. Vendors backport fixes out of order and sometimes change a kernel without changing the version string, so treat these numbers as a hint; the loader's own vulnerability check decides. CVE record lookups via cve.org returned TLS errors; the CVE IDs and fix kernels below come from the loader documentation cited in each row.

cves.name: DirtyFrag
cves.description: Android kernel page-cache write primitive reached through ESP-in-UDP (IPsec) decryption. Crafting IV = AES_ECB_DEC(key, current_content) XOR desired_content lets any 16-byte-aligned block in a mapped shared library be overwritten without write permission and without copy-on-write. The exploit patches shellcode into libc++.so in the kernel's page cache via a crash_dump64 bridge, then loads a custom kernel module (dfroot.ko) via insmod. Deterministic: a run either works or stops with an error. Root is ephemeral - the module and su are gone after reboot.
cves.affectedBranchesNote: DirtyFrag affects older branches than the patch floors listed; vendor backports vary.
cves.verified: Not independently verified against CVE/NVD (CVE record lookup blocked by TLS). Source: loader documentation.

cves.name: 98260 UAF
cves.description: POSIX CPU timers use-after-free (exec: Cleanup POSIX timers right after de_thread()). Used by RootMyS24's 98260 engine on One UI 9.0 / kernel 6.1.162 for Galaxy S24/S24 Ultra (CN/HK/TW), Z Flip6, and China Z Fold6. Implements a UMH pipe chain (uhexec → call_usermodehelper) without writing cred structures. Runs in a Shizuku UserService process; a failed attempt parks a zombie and the app allows one attempt per boot. Pairs with KernelSU 3.2.5 (ephemeral, --ephemeral) or 3.3.0 (experimental).
cves.affectedBranchesNote: Samsung Galaxy S24 series on One UI 9.0 / kernel 6.1.162. Documented by RootMyS24; not yet in the main CVE patch-floor table used for DirtyFrag/GhostLock.
cves.verified: Not independently verified against CVE/NVD (CVE record lookup blocked by TLS). Source: RootMyS24 documentation.

cves.name: GhostLock
cves.description: Futex PI (Priority Inheritance) use-after-free in the Linux kernel. The pselect6 syscall copies fd_set data onto the kernel stack; combined with the futex PI waiter mechanism, a freed stack frame can be reclaimed as an rt_mutex_waiter structure. The rb-tree rebalance during PI chain walk writes controlled values to arbitrary kernel addresses. Two root paths: Path A (UMH root, C ashmem devices) and Path B (Direct PI write, fallback). A race, so retries and kernel panics are normal; a working payload is tied to the exact kernel layout. Feasibility depends on compiler PGO/LTO profiles, not just kernel version.
cves.affectedBranchesNote: Linux kernel 5.7 ~ 7.1. Fixed in stable 6.1.175, 6.6.140, 6.12.86. Most Android devices remain unpatched as of September 2026. RootMyVivo GhostLock accepts 6.6 up to 6.6.139 and 6.1 up to 6.1.144; later releases carry the fix. Meta fixed GhostLock in Quest 3 incremental 52345320040100520 and Quest 3S 3697600032300610.
cves.verified: Not independently verified against CVE/NVD (CVE record lookup blocked by TLS). Source: loader documentation.

cves.name: Adreno GPU route
cves.description: GPU command-packet defect that lets the GPU overwrite its own page tables for physical read/write. RootMyVivo ships it for older 5.10/5.15 Snapdragon 8-class vivo and iQOO devices whose GPU firmware predates Qualcomm's June 2025 fix. Disables SELinux and spawns a root shell.
cves.affectedBranchesNote: Qualcomm Adreno KGSL issue fixed June 2025. Devices with GPU firmware predating the fix remain vulnerable. RootMyVivo catalog maxFixedKernel: 5.15.178 / 5.10.198.
cves.verified: Not independently verified against CVE/NVD (CVE record lookup blocked by TLS). Source: loader documentation.

safetySummary.temporaryVsPermanent: Temporary root lasts until a full reboot. KernelSU late-load, Magisk/APatch boot-image installs are permanent and need an unlocked bootloader. Do not confuse them.
safetySummary.shizukuIsNotRoot: Shizuku runs a service as the shell user (UID 2000) through ADB. It is not root, though several loaders use it as a transport.
safetySummary.noGuarantees: No risk-free, recovery, warranty, Knox, or Play Integrity guarantees. Strong integrity verdicts usually fail on rooted devices.
safetySummary.authorizedDevicesOnly: Only use hardware you own or have explicit permission to modify. Back up data you cannot lose.
safetySummary.noApkHosting: This site does not host APKs or binaries. Download from each project's own release page.
safetySummary.exactMatchRequired: Match exact model, build, and uname -r. A partial match is not enough; offsets come from a specific kernel build.
